title: Investigating the effects of the ARG258HIS mutation on RAD51C in inherited Fanconi Anemia and cancer disease.
authors: Seifeldin, Sara; Saeed, Mohd; Alshaghdali, Khalid; Yousif, Elgeli; Abu Sabaa, Amal; Rabie, Hatem; Siddiqui, Samra; Saeed, Amir
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过MD模拟和计算预测分析RAD51C蛋白R258H突变引起的结构失稳，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关蛋白但未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Fanconi anemia is a rare chromosomal instability disorder associated with developmental abnormalities, bone marrow failure, and a heightened susceptibility to leukemia and other cancers. It is an autosomal recessive genetic disorder, necessitating both parents to carry the faulty gene. Diagnostic methods include blood tests, chromosome breakage assessments, and genetic testing. While there is no cure, treatments encompass blood transfusions, bone marrow transplants, and gene therapy, with patients requiring regular check-ups, supportive care, and cancer screening to enhance their quality of life. In this study, we identify a specific substitution (R258H) targeting the crucial binding site of the alpha-helix region in RAD51C. This substitution induces structural disorder in distinct regions, as indicated by the near absence of electron density for multiple amino acids. Intriguingly, these disordered regions do not follow a continuous sequence from the mutation site and extend across domain boundaries. We utilized computational prediction algorithms and Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations to model RAD51C and its mutation (R258H) structurally. These simulations highlighted alterations in conformational dynamics, the Free Energy Landscape (FEL), and intrinsic molecular motions induced by the mutation, suggesting structural destabilization that could disrupt its function. This observed destabilization in RAD51C due to mutations offers valuable insights that may serve as diagnostic markers for individuals carrying these mutations, particularly in Fanconi anemia.
abstract_zh: 范可尼贫血是一种罕见的染色体不稳定性疾病，与发育异常、骨髓衰竭以及对白血病和其他癌症的高度易感性相关。它是一种常染色体隐性遗传病，要求父母双方均携带缺陷基因。诊断方法包括血液检测、染色体断裂评估和基因检测。尽管尚无治愈方法，治疗手段涵盖输血、骨髓移植和基因治疗，患者需定期检查、支持性护理和癌症筛查以提升生活质量。在本研究中，我们识别出针对RAD51C中α-螺旋区域关键结合位点的一个特定替换（R258H）。该替换诱导不同区域的结构紊乱，表现为多个氨基酸的电子密度近乎缺失。有趣的是，这些紊乱区域并非从突变位点起连续延伸，且跨越结构域边界。我们利用计算预测算法和分子动力学（Molecular Dynamics, MD）模拟对RAD51C及其突变（R258H）进行结构建模。这些模拟突显了突变诱导的构象动力学、自由能景观（Free Energy Landscape, FEL）和内在分子运动的变化，提示结构失稳可能破坏其功能。RAD51C因突变导致的这种失稳现象提供了宝贵见解，可能作为携带这些突变个体（尤其是范可尼贫血患者）的诊断标志物。
